description: A file that declares no test whose environment's teardown() throws. Jest's runTest awaits the teardown inside its try, so the throw rejects runTest and the scheduler's onFailure takes that error: the file prints the teardown's error, and onResult's "Your test suite must contain at least one test." check, which only looks at a result runTest returned, never runs. A file that has no test and no such error still prints the no-tests text (cli/empty-test-file). One Jest worker, the default reporter and --json.
